test_policy: The public outer test is untouched during search and used only after the best configuration is selected.
selection_scope: One fixed tuning seed is used for the compact search. Five seeds are used only for the final outer-test report.
multi_fidelity_note: The compact search uses fewer epochs than final retraining, especially for KGAT; this is a documented cost-saving approximation.

excluded.PGPR: official released runner has no independent validation path; kept at official settings
excluded.HeteroEmbed: handled by scripts/run_paper_heteroembed.py; not mixed with the RecBole search space
